packet_dag.terminal_condition: The One Time Operations Automations Center renders a readable, non-overlapping heading, filter toolbar, and empty/list state on desktop and mobile without changing automation data, permissions, helper prompts, or external-write behavior.

title: Automation Center Readability Cleanup

reasons: Fresh screenshots show the Operations Automations Center title rendered low-contrast over a dark portrait-backed panel.
The desktop filter card floats over the content area and visually cuts across the title/table region.
The empty table state is washed out against the dark/photo background and needs a stable route-specific layout treatment.
likely_external_provider_blockers: Live automation sends, publishes, payment/access actions, external account mutations, and provider connector writes are out of scope.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this automation-center readability cleanup, continue manual screenshot-reviewed packets for Operations participants/contact CRM polish or remaining portal visual defects.

operator_intent_summary: Make the Rabbi / One Time Automations Center feel even, clean, and loaded by fixing the unreadable title area, overlapping filter card, and washed empty state.

decisions_captured.decision: Production deploy/live-smoke target is still required before terminal app-visible Done.

out_of_scope: No automation create, edit, save, run, enable, disable, approval, permission, API, filter behavior, or helper prompt behavior change.
No public landing, parent portal, student portal, provider portal, member login, classroom, payments, email, WhatsApp, Telegram, Stripe, Drive, Vimeo, Zoom, DNS, account, or access-grant change.
No GHL runtime, LeadConnector reference, external CRM write, external send/publish/upload/payment, raw private evidence, or secret exposure.

inspection_targets: public/css/one-time-operations.css One Time Operations route overrides
known_blockers: Production deploy/live-smoke remains blocked until a target is explicit.
observed_visual_defects: The Automation Center title and description render dark-on-dark over the One Time portrait panel.
The desktop filter toolbar is visually detached and overlaps the page-heading/list area.
The empty-state panel appears as a low-contrast washed overlay instead of a deliberate table/list empty state.

expanded_phrases.clean: The automations route should have a quiet, readable admin layout with no photo overlay fighting the table/filter content.
expanded_phrases.even: The heading, toolbar, and empty/list state should align within one stable route container across desktop and mobile.
expanded_phrases.loads nicely: Once data loads, the route should immediately show a readable Automation Center title, counts, filters, and empty/list state without overlap.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: The automations route remains a first-party BNA Operations metadata view scoped to rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class.

requirements.statement: Fix the One Time Operations Automations Center readability and layout so the heading, filter toolbar, and empty/list state no longer render over a low-contrast portrait panel or overlap each other.
requirements.expected_result: Desktop and mobile automations screenshots show a readable title, subcopy, count summary, filter controls, and empty/list state in a stable admin layout with no horizontal overflow or clipped controls.
acceptance_criteria: The Automations Center route has a scoped One Time route marker for CSS targeting.
The route uses a compact solid/dark panel treatment rather than the portrait dashboard hero treatment.
Heading and toolbar text meet readable contrast on desktop and mobile.
Filter controls and empty/list states are contained, aligned, and non-overlapping on 1440px and 390px screenshots.
Automation metadata, filters, helper action, edit/detail action, APIs, action registry, and external-provider guardrails are unchanged.

criteria: Raw source and broad UI cleanup register exist for RAW-20260702-008.
Current screenshot evidence shows the automations route readability and overlap defects.
The likely fix is scoped to route marker markup and One Time Operations CSS overrides.
No automation behavior, external provider, money, access, credential, or account decision is required for local implementation.

findings.user_impact: The route looks unfinished because the heading and empty state are hard to read and the filter card appears to float over the content.
findings.expected_fix: Add a route marker and scoped One Time Automations CSS that uses a solid panel, readable text, contained toolbar, and intentional empty/list state.

requirements: Automation Center title, subcopy, toolbar summary, filter labels, and empty/list state meet readable contrast.
Filter controls remain visible and operable on mobile without horizontal overflow.
No additional unlabeled controls or missing h1 conditions are introduced.
test_expectations: Automations screenshot/probe reports no horizontal overflow or route-heading overlap.
